scope: Initial current-source rule map for NY Medicaid + Anthem NY
notice: These are source-attribution rules, not automated legal conclusions. Historical DOS applicability must be established from the version effective on the DOS.

rules.title: NY Medicaid managed-care provider enrollment requirement
rules.authority: New York State Department of Health
rules.currentSourceStatement: NYSDOH states that providers joining a managed care network also have to enroll with the New York State Medicaid program.

citation.sourceTitle: NYSDOH — Information for Health Care Providers
citation.excerpt: Providers will also have to enroll with the New York State Medicaid program.

rules.title: Anthem NY billed-code documentation support
rules.authority: Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield of New York
rules.currentSourceStatement: Anthem states that billed CPT, HCPCS and/or revenue codes should be fully supported in the medical record or office notes.

citation.excerpt: The billed code(s) should be fully supported in the medical record and/or office notes.

pdfCitation.locator: PDF viewer p. 171; manual printed p. 170 — Reimbursement Policies
pdfCitation.excerpt: The billed code(s) are required to be fully supported in the medical record and/or office notes.

rules.title: Anthem NY reimbursement-policy precedence
rules.authority: Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield of New York
rules.currentSourceStatement: Anthem states that its reimbursement policies may be superseded by state, federal or CMS requirements.

citation.excerpt: These policies may be superseded by state, federal or CMS requirements.

pdfCitation.locator: PDF viewer p. 171; manual printed p. 170 — Reimbursement Hierarchy
pdfCitation.excerpt: These policies may be superseded by mandates in provider, state, federal or CMS contracts.

rules.title: CMS Medicaid NCCI Policy Manual — 2026
rules.currentSourceStatement: CMS states that the 2026 Medicaid NCCI Policy Manual is effective January 1, 2026 and that prior annual versions are archived.

citation.excerpt: CMS updates the NCCI Policy Manual for Medicaid Services once a year.

rules.title: Anthem NY provider claim-payment dispute path
rules.authority: Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield of New York
rules.currentSourceStatement: Anthem provides a provider payment dispute process for finalized claims when a provider disagrees with the outcome.

citation.sourceTitle: Anthem NY — Claims submissions and disputes
citation.excerpt: Provider payment disputes apply when a provider disagrees with a finalized claim outcome.

citationContract.requirement: Every policy-level challenge must include at least one authoritative citation with source URL and locator.
citationContract.pdfRule: Where an authoritative PDF is available, deep-link to the relevant PDF page and show a short excerpt.
citationContract.htmlRule: Where supported, use a text-fragment deep link to highlight the relevant sentence.
citationContract.challengeGuard: POLICY_CONFLICT_CANDIDATE cannot be emitted unless a verified mismatch and at least one citation are present.
